description: This file contains debugging utilities for the ANGLE project, including logging, debug annotations, and platform-specific debug features.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Handles logging messages with severity and context information.

classes.name: ScopedPerfEventHelper
classes.description: Manages performance event scope for debugging.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Constructor for creating a log message with function, line, and severity.

methods.name: ~LogMessage
methods.description: Destructor that outputs the log message and handles fatal errors.

methods.name: getSeverity
methods.description: Returns the severity level of the log message.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the log message as a string.

methods.name: ScopedPerfEventHelper
methods.description: Constructor that begins a performance event for debugging.

methods.name: DebugAnnotationsActive
methods.description: Checks if debug annotations are active.

methods.name: DebugAnnotationsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if debug annotations are initialized.

methods.name: InitializeDebugAnnotations
methods.description: Initializes debug annotations with a given annotator.

methods.name: InitializeDebugMutexIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates a mutex for debugging if it does not exist.

methods.name: FmtHR
methods.description: Formats an HRESULT value as a hex string.

methods.name: FmtErr
methods.description: Formats a DWORD error code as a hex string.
